items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in a related field.
A minimum of four (4) years of related experience or an associate degree and two years of related experience is required.
Demonstrated administrative experience in a university or higher education environment.

General Administrative Duties. Provide direct administrative and calendaring support to the assigned unit department head. Serve as Pathway Programs suite space manager. Reserve and and provide scheduling updates for the Pathway Programs suite rooms. Assist with DocuSign management. May help to manage front office activities and serve as receptionist. Answer phones, direct traffic, sign for packages, and provide supervision to student workers. Assist director and office staff with clerical tasks to support activities which include but are not limited to preparing meeting agendas, taking meeting minutes, disseminating information, copying, filing, organizing, and processing/signing incoming and outgoing deliveries. Responsible for record management. Assist in creating posters and flyers. Attend and participate in monthly user group meetings to stay abreast of UC and UCR policy changes and updates. Serve as the first point of contact and subject matter expert for travel, procurement, reimbursements, and policy. Manage inventory and logs for for supplies and insignia items for Pathway Programs. Manage the IT Database renewal process for unit. Serve as back-up to Student Life/Event Coordinator & other SA Administrative Assistant & Executive Assistants for all matters related to travel and procurement. (35% time)

Financial and travel coordination. Serve as a Procurement Cardholder for the assigned units. This includes making purchases on the ProCard and adhering to the ProCard policy, processes, and procedures outlined by the unit, SOM, and campus. Responsible for the procurement function from initiation to end. Ensure goods/services ordered are received and that payments to vendors are issued in a timely manner and encumbrances are cleared. Initiate purchase orders and requests for general operations. These include but are not limited to: order office supplies, order goods and services, the independent contractor process, performance agreements, honorariums, sponsorships, gifts, and business card orders. Ensure timely processing of all purchase requisitions, reimbursements, travel expenditures, etc., to meet accounting requirements and fiscal deadlines. Serve as the primary Receiver for assigned units. Serve as primary travel delegate for Pathway Programs Director. Assist staff with travel requests (Pre-Trip & Expense Reporting ) including making travel arrangements for all business travel. Assist staff with travel and Concur inquiries. Provide traveler with guidance and resources related to travel. Verify all expenses submitted are allowable and permissible per policy and contract and grant (C&G) funding guidelines. Work with requestor/traveler to ensure documentation provided contain the required information required by policy and/or the C&G terms and conditions. Assist Pathway Program Director with expense tracking and reconciliation. Assist lead Analyst with monthly budget reports. Review and analyzes budget reports for discrepancies and works with Analysts to make corrections. Applies knowledge to prepare and/or review financial transactions while adhering to university and agency policies and procedures. (30% time)

Event Management. Responsible for all aspects of event planning for Pathway Program events (e.g., retreat, orientation, summer programs, graduation recognitions, etc.). This includes but is not limited to planning, calendaring and coordinating event logistics for assigned units. Events logistics may include but are not limited to, securing budgetary approval, initiating the approval forms, securing quotes, ordering food, initiating purchase orders, recharges, gathering RSVPs, sending out save the date reminders, etc. Responsible for post event management process. Serve as back-up to Student Life/Event Coordinator & other SA Administrative Assistant & Executive Assistants for all matters related to events. Assist and provide support with general SA annual events. (15% time)

Responsible for manage the Student Stipend Process. This includes but is not limited to coordinating, tracking, initiating, and reconciling all documentation related to the student stipend process. (10% time)

Assist the Pathway Programs Director and Assistant Director with analytical assignments including: researching, gathering, reviewing, analyzing, synthesizing information and data for consumption and provide recommendations as needed. Assist with metric tracking for the unit. (5% time)
Miscellaneous - Other duties as assigned. (5% time)

Exceptional organizational, time management and general office management skills. Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines working with frequent interruptions. Ability to work on multiple assignments and manage time effectively to ensure deadlines are met in a fast-paced office.
Knowledge of University policies and procedures related to procurement practices, equipment management, general accounting practices, account reconciliation, travel and entertainment reimbursement.

Ability to work within a team and establish and maintain cooperative working relationships. Ability to interact effectively as an individual and a team member with department staff, faculty, students and outside community members.
Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise discretion and sound judgment.
Excellent oral, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills. Skill in communicating effectively and professionally using tact and diplomacy with a diverse population.

Demonstrated ability to compose business correspondence, edit and use correct spelling, punctuation and grammar. Demonstrated skill in creating and editing documents in word processing applications using advanced features and creating spreadsheets and reports using Word, Excel, Power Point or other software applications.
Skill in accurate record keeping with strict attention to detail.
Ability to work with people from diverse cultural backgrounds
